Subject: Candidate Deliverable: prompt sent — submission window & reviewer queue

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with us yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is the take-home prompt and a short data sample you can use to validate the end-to-end flow. Key details below: 

- Deliverable: short design doc (max 2 pages) + a small prototype repo (link or zipped archive).
- Deadline: 72 hours from now — Tue Sep 17 09:00 AM PDT. If you need an extension, let us know and we'll consider on a case-by-case basis.
- Submission: reply to this thread with a public repo link or attach a ZIP. 

We've cc'd Jasmine (hiring manager) and Marissa (panel interviewer). Reviewers will be rotated to reduce bias; Marissa will take first pass and log feedback in the shared doc.

Attachment: 2027-09-14_sarah-nguyen_takehome-instructions.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

If anything is unclear, ask here — otherwise good luck and looking forward to seeing your work.

Best,
Logan Wright
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the question. Short answer: treat the latency budget as a design constraint rather than a hard requirement for the prototype — we care more about your trade-offs and how you would optimize for a production deployment. If you can demonstrate an approach that would hit ~200ms median at a small scale, that's a plus, but it's not mandatory for the prototype itself.

Repo: public GitHub link is fine. If you prefer private, please send a ZIP and we'll accept that.

Logan — for visibility on reviewer logistics: Marissa will do the first qualitative pass and populate the evaluation spreadsheet. After that, Alex (we've scheduled Alex as second reviewer but not cc'd here) will do a blind score. If Marissa needs follow-up, she'll flag us. The shared Drive folder (link below) has the rubric — please add Sarah's submission once it's in.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cTakehomePrompt

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu

- Marissa: first reviewer, please claim Sarah's submission in the Drive once it arrives and complete the qualitative notes by end of day Thursday (9/17).
- Alex: second blind reviewer; Jasmine will coordinate adding Alex into the sheet after Marissa's notes.
- Logan: I'll handle scheduling a short sync debrief (20m) if either reviewer requests it.
